note: Automatically crop captures when the camera is partially blocked by objects like a hat brim or hair.
note_it: Ritaglia automaticamente le acquisizioni quando la fotocamera è parzialmente bloccata da elementi come tese di cappelli o capelli.

label: Messenger contacts sync
note: Messenger contacts sync flag set by the phone. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Values are not named in the code; the phone sync sets it.

label: Meta AI handwriting
note: Turns on Meta AI handwriting input. The assistant runtime reads it as a switch.

label: Meta AI during calls
note: Lets Meta AI start while a phone call is active instead of being blocked.

label: Metadata
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

control.why: Part of the settings sync itself (SettingsSyncMetadata), not a stored setting.

label: Miranda DC service
note: Internal service flag. Nothing on the glasses reads it; stored and synced.

label: Mirrored notification apps
note: Per-app notification mirroring settings, stored on the glasses. Not for editing.

label: Double press for Meta AI
note: Setting for the double press that opens Meta AI. The glasses do not read it.

label: Meta AI consent
note: Consent record for multimodal Meta AI features. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Rollout target state
note: Rollout target of an internal config. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Mono audio
note: Play the same audio from the left and right speakers.
note_it: Riproduci lo stesso audio dagli altoparlanti sinistro e destro.

label: Motion blur reduction
note: Turns motion blur reduction on or off for video.

label: Media processing for photos
note: Turns media processing of unprocessed photos on or off.

label: Media processing for videos
note: Turns media processing of unprocessed videos on or off.

label: Playback while recording
note: Allow media to play while recording videos. Sound from your media may be captured.
note_it: Consenti la riproduzione di contenuti multimediali mentre registri video. Potrebbe essere registrato il suono dei tuoi contenuti multimediali.

label: Third music partner
note: Turns on a third music partner app.

label: Default pause length
note: Default length of an announcement pause, in seconds. The Meta app offers 1, 2, 4 and 8 hours.

label: Announcements paused until
note: Time until incoming call announcements stay muted, as epoch seconds. Empty means not muted.

label: Announcement pause mode
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: Talk without the wake phrase
note: Lets you talk to the assistant without saying the wake phrase first.

label: Nose occlusion tuning
note: Tuning flag for how the nose is detected in the camera view.

label: Notification LED brightness
note: Brightness of the alert light. The Java LED code uses one fixed level whatever this is set to.

label: Notification volume
note: Level of notification sounds on the audio system's absolute scale.

label: Occlusion detection
note: Detects when something blocks the camera view.

label: Setup session id
note: Id of the first-time setup session.

label: Oxide
note: Runs the Oxide and Meta AI services and sends the wake word to Meta AI.

label: Paired phone system
note: Records the type of phone the glasses are paired with. Nothing on the glasses acts on it. Phone type the glasses record when paired; nothing for the user to change.

label: Palm unlock early access
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Palm unlock
note: Securely unlock your glasses without using your phone.
note_it: Sblocca in modo sicuro i tuoi occhiali senza usare il tuo telefono.

label: Partner app settings
note: Settings and display info for partner apps, stored as a protobuf the phone app writes.

label: Passive audio capture
note: Background audio capture switch for the glasses assistant.

label: Passive audio: own speech only
note: Limits passive audio capture to the own speech of the wearer. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Passive meal capture
note: Turns passive meal capture on or off. Off by default.

label: Passive phone unlock
note: Turns passive phone unlock on or off.

label: Passive visual capture
note: Turns passive camera capture on or off. The phone app settings page writes it.

label: Phone contacts sync
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it. Integer the phone app writes; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Posture detection
note: Turns posture detection on or off. The phone app lists it; the glasses do not read it.

label: India QR payments (MC)
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: India QR payments setup done
note: Records that the India QR payments setup is done.

label: QR payments in India
note: Turns QR payments on or off in India.

label: UPI eligible
note: Eligibility flag for UPI payments. Set by the system, not the user.

label: QR payments via WhatsApp
note: Turns on QR payments through WhatsApp in India.

label: Quick action
note: Chooses what the quick action does: send a message, a voice message, or a call.

options.label: Voice messaging
options.detail: Only available for WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram
options.detail_it: Disponibile solo per WhatsApp, Messenger e Instagram

label: Dynamic photo
note: Capture more frames with each photo, so you can choose your favorite.
note_it: Acquisisci più fotogrammi con ogni foto per scegliere quello che preferisci.

label: QVA
note: Turns on the QVA audio feature, which the audio server only enables on one device model.

label: QVA wellness sync
note: Syncs wellness data. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Reminders early access
note: Turns the early-access reminders feature on or off.

label: Resolution and frame rate
note: Changing resolution or frame rate affects battery life, storage, recording duration, and orientation.
note_it: La modifica della risoluzione o della frequenza dei fotogrammi influisce su autonomia della batteria, spazio, durata di registrazione e orientamento.

label: Sample app 1
note: Test toggle for a sample app. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Screen brightness
note: Sets display brightness. The stored value is a level; the brightness controls also take 1 to 100 percent.

label: Auto brightness
note: Adjusts glasses display brightness based on your environment
note_it: Regola la luminosità del display degli occhiali in base all'ambiente circostante

label: SDR video
note: Turns SDR video on or off. The glasses' camera UI reads it.

label: Account sync metadata
note: Account sync data kept as a string. Not for editing.

label: Action button long press (flag)
note: Long press on the action button. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Action button short press (flag)
note: Old flag for the action button short press. The action button mapping setting is used instead.

label: Mirror phone notifications
note: Lets phone notifications show on the glasses.

label: Touchpad interaction model
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: Touchpad model coherence
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it. Integer; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Invert swipe horizontal
note: Reverses horizontal swipes on the touchpad.

label: Invert swipe vertical
note: Reverses vertical swipes on the touchpad.

label: Invert swipe horizontal
note: Stored and synced only. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Invert swipe vertical
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Disable thermal shutdown
note: Stops the glasses shutting down when a skin sensor reads too hot. For testing. Visor never writes it.

control.why: Turning it off removes the protection against the glasses burning skin.

label: Display heat protection
note: For glasses with a display; these have none, so it does nothing here.

label: Display timeout event
note: Turns on a display timeout event. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Do not disturb
note: Silences call ringing on the glasses while on.

label: Display off from neural band
note: Lets the neural band turn the display off.

label: Neural band instant action
note: Action number for the neural band instant gesture. Values are not listed in the code.

label: Glasses setup status
note: Setup progress of the glasses, written by the system. Not for editing. Status written by the system; value names are not defined in the code.

label: Headphone mode
note: Switches the glasses audio to headphone mode.

label: Instant action
note: Touchpad instant action, stored as a number. The value names are not decoded yet, so it is read-only. Value names are not decoded; do not write until decoded.

label: Invert wrist roll
note: Would reverse wrist roll direction. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Live transcription in Meta AI
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.

label: Companion app setup status
note: Shows how far the phone companion app setup has got. The glasses write it. Status the glasses write during setup; not user-set.

label: Sample setting
note: Sample key from the settings SDK. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Screen reader
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Speaking pitch
note: Pitch of the screen reader voice. The glasses code does not read this key.

label: Speaking rate
note: How fast the screen reader speaks. The phone slider runs from 0 to 100.

label: Display temperature warning
note: For glasses with a display; these have none, so it does nothing here.

label: Simplified touchpad calling
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.

label: Zoom level
note: Display magnification mirrored from the phone. The stored int is an index into seven scales.

label: Enable screen reader
note: Copies the phone's TalkBack setting to the glasses.

label: Text size
note: Text size mirrored from the phone. The stored int is an index; the glasses map it to a font scale.

label: Messaging setup status
note: Per-provider linking state for messaging apps, stored as base64 protobuf. The phone app reads it; the glasses do not.

label: Allow input during setup
note: Blocks the assistant trigger while this and setup-complete are both 0. Any non-zero value is on.

label: Suggested replies
note: Show quick, suggested responses based on conversation context.
note_it: Mostra risposte rapide suggerite in base al contesto della conversazione.

label: Spatial audio
note: Plays media as plain stereo or as spatial audio.

options.label: Stereo
options.detail_it: Ideale per la maggior parte delle esperienze di ascolto

options.label: Spatial
options.detail: Simulates an immersive sound for your media
options.detail_it: Simula un audio immersivo per il tuo contenuto multimediale

label: Spotify Tap
note: Tap and hold the glasses to play Spotify.

label: Band on standby: index finger instant action
note: Action for an index finger gesture on standby. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Band on standby: middle finger instant action
note: Key the band sends for a middle-finger instant action on standby. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Tap and hold prompt
note: Prompt the assistant uses for the tap and hold action.

label: Tap and hold action
note: Chooses what a touchpad tap and hold does, such as opening Meta AI or playing music.

label: Telecom untethered relay
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Telecom glasses key ID
note: Identifier of the glasses' telecom encryption key. Stored and synced only.

label: Telecom relay status
note: State of the telecom relay that works without the phone connected, as the phone reports it.

label: Test switch (developer)
note: Developer test switch. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Test float (developer)
note: Test value with no effect. Only the mobile-config defaults and name tables use it.

label: Test int (developer)
note: Developer test value. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Developer test value with no bounds, so nothing to offer.

label: Test int32 (developer)
note: Developer test value. Nothing on the glasses acts on it.

label: Test text (developer)
note: Meta's test key; nothing reads it.

label: Test shared int (developer)
note: Test value for checking settings sync. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Developer test value; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Test shared text (developer)
note: Meta's test key; nothing reads it.

label: Speech speed
note: How fast the glasses speak. 100 is normal speed.

label: Two-stage stabilization
note: Two-stage image stabilization for video.

label: Stabilization buffer size
note: Buffer size for two-stage video stabilisation. The code gives no unit or range, so it is read-only. No unit or bounds in the code, so no range can be offered.

label: Stabilisation buffer size (3K)
note: Stabilisation buffer size for the 3K variant. No code on the glasses uses it.

control.why: This firmware does not have it: no code reads it and no app defines its type, so there is nothing to encode a value as.

label: Stabilization neighbor frames
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this count; it is stored and synced only.

label: Stabilisation neighbour frames (3K)
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

control.why: This firmware does not have it: no code reads it and no app defines its type, so there is nothing to encode a value as.

label: Stabilized output height
note: Output height in pixels for two-stage stabilization. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Stabilisation output height (3K)
note: Stabilised output height for 3K video. This firmware does not use it.

control.why: This firmware does not have it: no code reads it and no app defines its type, so there is nothing to encode a value as.

label: Stabilized output width
note: Output width of stabilized video, in pixels.

label: Stabilisation output width (3K)
note: Stabilised output width for 3K video. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

control.why: This firmware does not have it: no code reads it and no app defines its type, so there is nothing to encode a value as.

label: Announce calls
note: Hear who's calling you.
note_it: Senti chi ti sta chiamando.

label: Verified sessions
note: After a phone unlock, the session stays verified until you take the glasses off.

label: Video length
note: Choose a maximum video length. These limits help optimize for sharing and space.
note_it: Scegli una durata massima del video. Questi limiti aiutano a ottimizzare la condivisione e lo spazio.

label: Video frame rate
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: HDR video
note: Sets the HDR mode for video. Values are not named in the code read. Integer passed to the camera HAL; its value names are not decoded.

label: Stabilization mode
note: Stored and synced only. The camera reads the eis_mode setting instead.

label: White balance
note: Fixed colour temperature for video, 2000 to 8000 K. 0 lets the camera choose.

label: Voice memo eligibility
note: Result of the voice memo eligibility check, written by the system.

label: Voice notes early access
note: Early access switch for voice notes.

label: Audible alerts
note: Assistant will announce device status and errors.
note_it: Assistant annuncerà lo stato del dispositivo e gli errori.

label: Wake duration
note: Wake-up duration read by the always-on camera service. The unit and range are not in the binary.

label: Choose hand
note: Which hand the always-on camera tracks for wake gestures.

label: Wake-only mode
note: Keeps the always-on camera off until you wake the glasses.

label: Thumb to middle finger distance
note: Distance threshold for the thumb-to-middle-finger wake gesture. The code gives no unit.

label: "Hey Meta"
note: Say "Hey Meta" or "OK Meta" to start a voice command.
note_it: Di' "Hey Meta" o "Ok Meta" per iniziare un comando vocale.

label: Wake sound
note: Your glasses will make a sound after you say "Hey Meta" or "OK Meta."
note_it: I tuoi occhiali emetteranno un suono quando dici "Hey Meta" o "Ok Meta".

label: Water eject
note: Clears water from the speaker with an ejection sound.

label: Wear detection
note: Features will pause when you take off your glasses and resume when you put them back on.
note_it: Le funzioni saranno messe in pausa quando rimuovi gli occhiali e riprenderanno quando li indossi di nuovo.

label: Glasses encryption key ID
note: ID of the glasses end-to-end encryption key. The phone sets it during relay setup.

label: Glasses relay status
note: State of the relay that works without the phone connected, as the phone reports it. The phone sets it from its relay state machine.

label: Link previews in messages
note: Link previews in messages. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Wellness partner 1
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.

label: Wellness partner 5
note: Turns on a wellness partner feature flag.

label: WhatsApp contacts sync
note: WhatsApp contact sync status. Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Wi-Fi password
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Wi-Fi network name
note: Name of the Wi-Fi network the glasses join.
